name: Gamilu – Gamification, Points, Badges & Rewards
author: okmultimedia

sections.description:
Make your site a little more fun. Gamilu rewards your users with points when they sign up, come back, publish or comment. Points unlock badges and move them up levels, and a friendly otter pops up to celebrate each achievement.

No complicated setup: a three-step welcome wizard, twelve ready-made badges and four levels are waiting for you the moment you activate it.

What you get

  • Points for signing up, visiting (once a day), publishing posts and writing comments. You choose how many, and set daily limits.
  • Twelve hand-drawn badges ready to use, or upload your own pictures.
  • Levels (Bronze, Silver, Gold and Diamond out of the box), fully editable.
  • Call your points whatever you like: coins, stars, gems…
  • User card with points, level, a progress bar and latest badges.
  • Badge gallery showing what each user has earned and what is still to come.
  • Celebration notice with the Gamilu otter and a little confetti when a user earns something. You can switch it off.
  • Blocks and shortcodes: works with the block editor, page builders and classic themes.
  • Users screen with each user’s history and manual adjustments.
  • Privacy friendly: works with the WordPress tools to export and erase personal data. No tracking, no external calls.

Add-ons

Gamilu is complete and free on its own. If you want more, optional add-ons are separate plugins: some are free and some are premium. You will find them in Gamilu > Add-ons. Nothing in Gamilu is locked or limited without them.

Shortcodes

  • [gamilu_card] – points, level, progress and latest badges of the logged-in user.
  • [gamilu_badges] – all badges, earned and still to earn.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Gamilu from Plugins > Add New Plugin.
  2. Follow the three-step welcome wizard.
  3. Add the “Gamilu: user card” block (or the [gamilu_card] shortcode) to any page.
sections.faq:
Do visitors who are not logged in earn points?

No. Points belong to registered users. Visitors see a friendly invitation to log in.

Can I take points away?

Yes, from Gamilu > Users, with a reason that only you can see.

What happens to the data if I delete the plugin?

Nothing is deleted unless you tick “Delete all Gamilu data” in Gamilu > Settings first.

  • Users screen with history and manual adjustments.
  • Works with the WordPress tools to export and erase personal data.
